gloss: as usual; as before; same as always

definitions.gloss: as usual; as before; same as always
definitions.explanation: Expresses that something should stay or will stay the same as it has been up to now, emphasizing continuity and the absence of change. Very natural in both spoken and written Japanese.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The same as before is fine.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live the same life as before.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{今|いま}まで{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Even though the department head has changed, please continue working the same way as before.

notes:
A very common expression combining ⟦{今|いま}まで→今まで：11546_imamade⟧ (until now) and {通|どお}り (as, in the manner of). Used to express continuity — that something should stay or will stay the same as it has been. Natural in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り + verb: to do something as usual
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: the same ~ as usual
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live as one always has

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り→以前通り：22078_izendoori⟧ — as before (slightly more formal; emphasizes a past reference point)
- ⟦{従来|じゅうらい}{通|どお}り→従来通り：15458_juuraidoori⟧ — as has been conventionally done (formal/institutional)
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{通|どお}り — as always (focuses on habitual pattern)
